name: Lythravel
storyline: Long ago the sister goddesses Lythra, Goddess of Dawn, and Velnara, Goddess of Dusk, wove the world together and named it Lythravel after their bond. When mortals learned to mine Aetherite, the crystallized breath of the goddesses, their greed cracked the world's heart, and the cataclysm known as the Shattering broke reality into countless crystalline cubes. Each goddess blamed the other's children. Lythra gathered the survivors of the sunlit lands into the Covenant of Dawn, Velnara raised the peoples of the ashen dark into the Dominion of Dusk, and both now fight for the Riftlands around the world's broken heart, because whoever holds them channels their goddess's Blessing onto all her children.
summary: Lythravel is a free-to-play 3D voxel fantasy MMORPG played directly in a desktop web browser, with nothing to download or install. Two factions, the Covenant of Dawn and the Dominion of Dusk, fight an endless war over the Riftlands, each from its own continent of six zones spanning levels 1 to 50. Players choose one of six classes (Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage or Priest, each with a mirrored counterpart on the Dusk side), allocate stat points freely every level and rank up their skills. Group content includes six dungeons, the 12-player raid Sanctum of the Shattering and world bosses in the Riftlands. PvP takes place in level-bracketed open-world zones, 10v10 battlegrounds and duels. Optional Veteran and Mythic modes trade slower progression for stronger gear, and Mythic characters can die permanently. Gear can be socketed with soulshards and enhanced up to +20 at the risk of losing it. Mounts, guilds, an auction house, crafting, gathering and fishing round out the world.
